title: Secret-scan check in CI
prompt:
Add a secret scan to CI (e.g. gitleaks action, or a regex script for sk-…, api keys, tokens). Ensure it scans the diff/tree and fails on a hit. Confirm .env.example exists and contains only placeholders.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Implemented scripts/secret_scan.py to enforce PRD §7.4 (no secrets in the repo) as a self-contained in-repo regex scanner that ACTIVATES the existing ci.yml forward-compatible guard (if [ -f scripts/secret_scan.py ]) — no workflow edit needed, path matched exactly. TDD: wrote tests/test_secret_scan.py FIRST (14 cases: scan_text flags sk-/sk-ant-/AKIA/PEM patterns; ignores your-..-here, xxxxx, empty .env.example values, and clean prose; main() exits 0 on a clean tree and 1 listing the file on a planted secret; excluded dirs .git/.venv don't trip; PATTERNS/ALLOWLIST are named config; live committed tree passes) — watched 14 fail (red), then implemented (green). Detection is driven by single named configs PATTERNS (anthropic-key, openai-key, aws-access-key, pem-private-key) and ALLOWLIST placeholder tokens (no scattered magic regex, §7.2). scan_text() is filesystem-independent + importable so it is unit-tested against in-memory strings; find_secrets()/main() walk the tree skipping EXCLUDED_DIRS (.git/.venv/caches AND tests/, whose fixtures plant clearly-fake pattern-matching strings on purpose) and SCANNED_SUFFIXES text-like files. The single planted 'secret' is a clearly-fake in-test literal (sk-/AKIA/PEM built from repeated chars) kept only in the test file; the real-tree walk excludes tests/ so the live scan still exits 0. Output via stdlib logging (LOG surface still a skeleton at scaffold stage); no external API calls, so the API gatekeeper (Epic 13) is N/A. .env.example (from 0.7) verified to contain only placeholders (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-anthropic-api-key-here, empty SEARCH_API_KEY/PRO_MODEL/CON_MODEL). Brought the script into the gate: added scripts/secret_scan.py to mypy [tool.mypy].files (mirrors 0.10); ruff extend-exclude unchanged (only create_issues.py excluded). Script is 154 file lines / well under 150 CODE lines (line-limit check exits 0). Gates green: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 23 files already formatted; mypy = no issues in 23 source files; pytest --cov = 70 passed, 100% coverage (Required 85.0% reached); python scripts/check_line_limit.py exits 0; python scripts/secret_scan.py exits 0 on the current tree — the secret-scan gate is now LIVE in CI.
